hero.heading:
Mel
McCutcheon
hero.tagline: Forest sister uprooted and self-sown, making music to lift, lighten, ignite and inspire.

about.heading:
A Voice For
The Late Set
about.leadText: Singing silky smooth, sweet, and sometimes a wee bit sticky.
paragraphs: Based on Vancouver Island, Mel McCutcheon has become a fixture of the region's jazz rooms — a voice that moves easily between the warmth of a big band and the intimacy of a quartet.
She currently fronts three different Vancouver Island ensembles, each built for a different room, a different band, the same unmistakable voice.

sound.heading:
Standards, Swing
& A Little Smoke
sound.bodyText: Timeless jazz standards, swinging favourites, Latin grooves and imaginative new arrangements — songs made famous by Sinatra, Bobby Darin and the golden age of jazz.

items.name: The Sharp Seven
items.description: Big-band jazz with Paul Nuez, Grahame Edwards, Michelle Draper, Jack Reynolds, Beau Stocker and Dave Lymburner. Built for a dance floor.

items.name: Mel McCutcheon Quartet
items.description: A smaller combo for intimate rooms and private events — most recently the Hearts for Hospice benefit.

items.name: Vintage Velvet
items.description: A quintet built around Mel's soulful, Vaughan- and Simone-inflected side. Late nights, low light.

items.detail: , Campbell River — with The Sharp Seven
